name: harness-engineering
description: Apply staged setup-time docs and configuration guardrails with docs-adjacent metadata.

interface.shortDescription: Apply staged docs/config guardrails to target repositories.
interface.longDescription: Install the Harness Engineering plugin to inspect a target repository, generate docs/harness-engineering/harness-engineering.json as visible docs-adjacent harness metadata, apply root CLAUDE.md plus AGENTS.md -> CLAUDE.md, root ARCHITECTURE.md, staged guardrail docs, scripts, CI, git hooks, readiness scoring, generated-doc provenance, and harness engineering validation. The core scope stays narrow; project-specific build or runtime integration packs may layer additional surfaces separately.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository and draft docs/harness-engineering/harness-engineering.json with staged guardrails, root CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md -> CLAUDE.md, and root ARCHITECTURE.md defaults.
Install the configured docs, scripts, advisory hooks, CI gates, and readiness scaffolding without overwriting existing files.
Validate this repository's harness against docs/harness-engineering/harness-engineering.json and report conflicts or drift.
Update the staged guardrails after this repo changed its schema sources, generated docs, CI provider, readiness level, user requirement rules, or layer model.
